# Security Guidelines


## Core Security Architecture

The TenX platform implements a sophisticated security architecture that addresses the unique challenges of blockchain-based learning management systems. The security framework acknowledges specific vulnerabilities inherent in blockchain implementations, including dependencies on block information and potential front-running scenarios[5](https://cdn.prod.website-files.com/65d35b01a4034b72499019e8/66459d3e444019e25078b9a8_ChainSecurity_TenX_compressed.pdf). These security considerations are fundamental to maintaining the platform's integrity and protecting user data and transactions.  
Block timestamp dependencies represent a critical security consideration, with the platform's PermissionedRegulator contract utilizing block.timestamp fields in functions such as canSend(), canReceive(), isTimelocked(), and setPermission()[5](https://cdn.prod.website-files.com/65d35b01a4034b72499019e8/66459d3e444019e25078b9a8_ChainSecurity_TenX_compressed.pdf). While block manipulation is considered difficult to execute, malicious miners can potentially manipulate block timestamps by up to 900 seconds compared to actual time. The platform adheres to the 15-second rule to mitigate these risks and ensure temporal security.

## Transaction Security and Front-Running Protection

The platform's transaction security model addresses potential front-running vulnerabilities in claim issuance and processing systems. When issuers create claims containing specific amounts and designated payees, subsequent updates to claim amounts can be vulnerable to front-running attacks[5](https://cdn.prod.website-files.com/65d35b01a4034b72499019e8/66459d3e444019e25078b9a8_ChainSecurity_TenX_compressed.pdf). If claimable amounts are reduced in updated claims, payees can potentially front-run these updates by executing claim functions before the updates are processed, thereby receiving higher amounts than intended.  
While this vulnerability has been acknowledged and classified as low likelihood with medium impact, the platform maintains this functionality to support re-issuance of unclaimed claims with incorrect amounts[5](https://cdn.prod.website-files.com/65d35b01a4034b72499019e8/66459d3e444019e25078b9a8_ChainSecurity_TenX_compressed.pdf). The security framework requires comprehensive documentation of this functionality to ensure all stakeholders understand the associated risks and mitigation strategies.

## Token Security and Reward Systems

The TenX token security model implements sophisticated mechanisms to prevent unauthorized token withdrawals and reward manipulation. The platform has addressed critical vulnerabilities related to damping value recalculation during token redemption, ensuring that users cannot claim higher reward amounts than their legitimate entitlements[5](https://cdn.prod.website-files.com/65d35b01a4034b72499019e8/66459d3e444019e25078b9a8_ChainSecurity_TenX_compressed.pdf). The security framework prevents the theft of reward tokens from honest users through improved damping calculations and totalRewards variable updates.  
Double reward vulnerabilities have been identified and mitigated through careful analysis of token transfer mechanisms and damping updates[5](https://cdn.prod.website-files.com/65d35b01a4034b72499019e8/66459d3e444019e25078b9a8_ChainSecurity_TenX_compressed.pdf). While theoretical scenarios exist where token holders could claim double rewards through numerous transfers with minimal token amounts, the high gas costs associated with such attacks make them economically unfeasible. The platform continues to monitor these potential attack vectors and maintains robust defenses against reward manipulation.

## KYC and Regulatory Compliance

The TenX platform implements Know Your Customer (KYC) requirements that restrict token transfers to approved accounts only. However, the BasicRegulator contract configuration requires careful documentation to ensure clarity between stated claims and actual implementation[5](https://cdn.prod.website-files.com/65d35b01a4034b72499019e8/66459d3e444019e25078b9a8_ChainSecurity_TenX_compressed.pdf). The platform's legal framework supports the current BasicRegulator implementation, but comprehensive documentation updates are necessary to clearly explain both contract types and their intended usage scenarios.  
The regulatory compliance framework ensures that all platform operations align with applicable legal requirements while maintaining the flexibility necessary for blockchain-based educational systems. This approach balances regulatory compliance with the decentralized nature of blockchain technology, providing a secure foundation for educational transactions and user interactions.
